claims.statement: DemoCo files in one jurisdiction at an enacted 25% rate with no enacted change; the provision covers FY2026 under ASC 740.

claims.conclusion: Current tax recomputes from pretax income and the differences.
claims.statement: Taxable income is 940,000 USD after 30,000 USD of permanent differences and the net 90,000 USD reduction from temporary differences, giving current tax expense of 235,000 USD.

claims.conclusion: Deferred balances recompute from the cumulative differences at the enacted rate.
claims.statement: Deferred tax assets fall from 45,000 to 37,500 USD and deferred tax liabilities rise from 50,000 to 65,000 USD at 25%, moving the net deferred position from a 25,000 USD liability to a 27,500 USD liability and producing 2,500 USD of deferred tax expense.

claims.conclusion: Allowance released; uncertain position measured and presented as a liability.
claims.statement: The 20,000 USD valuation allowance is released because realization of the remaining deferred tax asset is more likely than not; unrecognized tax benefits of 25,000 USD are carried as a liability, 10,000 USD of which arose in FY2026.

claims.conclusion: Rate reconciliation ties; provision entries derived from the calculation.
claims.statement: The 247,500 USD provision reconciles from the 250,000 USD statutory expectation through permanent differences (7,500), the allowance release (-20,000) and unrecognized tax benefits (10,000), an effective rate of 24.75%; the provision entries book current tax, the unrecognized-benefit liability and the deferred movement.
